Uyghur.etym: From Uyghur ئۇيغۇر (uyghur). Introduced as part of national delimitation in the Soviet Union, reviving the name used by the Uyghur Khaganate. See Uyghurs on Wikipedia.Wikipedia

g: A member of a Turkic ethnic group living in northwestern China and southeastern Kazakhstan.
The language of the Uyghur people.
Of, from, or pertaining to the Uyghur people or the Uyghur language.
x: Hotan is located in southern Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. It is an oasis town in the Tarim Basin, north of the Kunlun Mountains and south of the Taklamakan Desert. Hotan Prefecture is a multinational area: 96 percent Uyghur and 3 percent Han.
